Author: SunnysOfficial
Name: Venue Mapper
Description: A Dalamud plugin for discovering FFXIV venues with 2D/3D interactive markers, live events, and built-in owner tools. Your complete FFXIV venue guide.
TestingChangelog:
## v0.6.0.2 (Testing)

- Improved: Chat links find longer venue names in lower case or written together
- Changed: Testing builds are marked more clearly
- Changed: Smaller house rules pill in the map header

## v0.6.0.1 (Testing)

- Added: Interface size setting from 50 to 150 percent
- Improved: Smarter chat venue links
- Improved: Next event shown even when it is more than a week away
- Fixed: Passport stamp dots no longer overlap long names
- Improved: Less stutter when entering a house
Changelog:
## v0.6.0

- Changed: New look for the whole plugin, with every venue in its own colors
- Added: Festivals with several days, houses and a preview
- Added: Venue passport with stamps for every venue you visit
- Added: Map markers, signs and an indoor guide to the right room
- Added: Venue names in chat become links
- Added: Update Notes window and big arrival banners
- Changed: Settings sorted into groups with short explanations
